plans.objective: [DIM: composition] The rigid family corresponds to functions expressible in a fixed low-dimensional basis (e.g., degree-d monomials), while the fat family corresponds to high-degree random polynomial expansions with unbounded coefficient space.

steps.description: Implement the `family` function to generate training and held-out constraint points for two function classes: (1) Rigid family — low-degree monomials (degree-d) with fixed basis, ensuring low-dimensional solution space; (2) Fat family — high-degree random polynomial expansions with unbounded coefficient space. Ensure all outputs are (N,1)-shaped arrays, held-out points do not overlap with training points, and y/yv are normalized to O(1) scale (std ≲ 10) to make the 1e-3 zero-violation criterion meaningful. This is the only function to be implemented per the script contract; the capacity_scan infrastructure will handle width scanning, optimization, and N_c determination.
